principle: Any tool output containing content not written by a trusted input during this session is untrusted. Absence of taint is never proof of safety: when a definition does not establish who wrote a field, the output is untrusted. Classifications follow from tool definitions only, never from knowledge of where a benchmark places injections.

rationale.get_iban: Returns the account's own IBAN (structured, not third-party text). Read-only; trusted.
rationale.get_balance: Returns the account balance (a number). Read-only; trusted.
rationale.get_most_recent_transactions: Returns Transaction records whose free-text `subject` and `sender` are written by counterparties, not by a trusted input this session. Read-only; UNTRUSTED output under the principle.
rationale.get_scheduled_transactions: Returns Transaction records whose free-text `subject` was not written by a trusted input during this session (the definition does not establish who wrote it). Read-only; UNTRUSTED output under the principle.
rationale.read_file: Returns arbitrary file contents (`filesystem.files`), not written by a trusted input this session. Read-only; UNTRUSTED output under the principle.
rationale.get_user_info: Returns the account holder's own profile fields. Read-only; trusted.
rationale.send_money: Appends an outgoing Transaction to the account. State-changing.
rationale.schedule_transaction: Appends a scheduled (optionally recurring) outgoing Transaction. State-changing.
rationale.update_scheduled_transaction: Changes recipient/amount/subject/date/recurrence of a scheduled Transaction. State-changing.
rationale.update_password: Sets the account password. State-changing; account identity (credential).
rationale.update_user_info: Changes the account holder's name/street/city. State-changing; account identity.
